# Contributing

This is a curated list, so inclusion is ultimately a maintainership decision rather than an entitlement based on satisfying a checklist. Please keep proposals focused on the category being requested and on evidence that is practical to verify.

## Categories

The main multiplexer sections and the Utilities section use different tests.

- Entries proposed as terminal multiplexers must satisfy the README's PTY/session-management criteria themselves.
- Utilities do not need to be terminal multiplexers themselves, but must provide substantial functionality specifically for configuring, controlling, restoring, automating, or otherwise integrating with one or more qualifying terminal multiplexers.
- General terminal, SSH, remote-access, tab/pane, or workspace functionality is not enough on its own.

When proposing closed-source or otherwise non-inspectable software, provide public documentation or other independently verifiable evidence for the relevant functionality. Maintainers are not expected to reverse-engineer a product or repeatedly investigate claims that cannot reasonably be verified.

## Discussion

Concise clarification and new evidence are welcome. Repeated restatements, including large AI-generated arguments, do not make an entry more eligible and can impose disproportionate review effort. If a proposal is declined, please only continue the eligibility discussion when there is materially new information or a genuine misunderstanding to resolve.
